title: Jonas: Your Personal Austrian German Tutor
description: Meet Jonas, a friendly AI chatbot designed to be your personal guide to Austrian German and culture. I built Jonas to be more than just a language app; he's a conversational partner who makes learning feel like chatting with a local. Using a fine-tuned language model and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system I built with FAISS, Jonas can answer your questions about Austria, explain grammar in a simple way, and teach you everything from classic phrases to modern slang. The whole experience is delivered through a web interface I created with Flask, with streaming responses for a natural, real-time conversation. It was a fun project that combined my passion for language, culture, and cutting-edge AI.
